summary: Spore entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Spore
entries.definitive_edition: Base game plus Galactic Adventures plus Creepy & Cute Parts Pack

emulation.notes: Use the current native or official release route where available.

primary.version: Spore with Galactic Adventures and Creepy & Cute Parts Pack
primary.why: The Windows PC route is the most complete route because Steam's More Spore bundle includes the base game, Galactic Adventures, and Creepy & Cute Parts Pack, and Galactic Adventures includes mission/adventure-creator content.
primary.how_to_play: Install the base game, Creepy & Cute, and Galactic Adventures on Windows, then launch through Galactic Adventures for the main run. Apply compatibility fixes/mod notes carefully and record whether online sharing features are functional.

entries.remaster_caveats: Old online sharing/account features may be unreliable; check for compatibility fixes and note any offline-only capture limitations.
